label: Sec. 01 Intro
title: Bitcoin as open money. Open intelligence.
money: Bitcoin is an open monetary network. It enables people to hold and transfer value without relying on a central issuer or a single company to operate the system. The challenge is making it useful: designing clear, accessible experiences for saving, sending and receiving money across different contexts.
intelligence: Open intelligence is about who can access, inspect, run and adapt the tools behind artificial intelligence. It includes open models, infrastructure and practical interfaces that give people and organisations more choice over how these systems work and where their data goes.
brief: This pathway is for practical projects that improve how people understand, access and use Bitcoin or open intelligence. That might mean designing products and services, improving onboarding and education, building useful tools, or exploring the experience of these systems in real settings. Projects may focus on either area or explore where they intersect.
support: UNBLOCKED works with applicants to develop the idea, strengthen the project plan and prepare a considered proposal. Spiral reviews proposals and makes its own funding decisions. Support from UNBLOCKED does not guarantee a grant.
